spec.name: M7.ClosedSolve.closed_pointwise
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2 → M7.Connectivity.connected c → M6.Final.PointwiseCorrect N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)
spec.guidance: This is the smallest missing wiring, not a new counting or witness theorem. Accepted M7.Connectivity.connected_admissible gives the actual M6.Final.Admissible predicate from the original anchored equal-card connected supports. Accepted sealed M6.Final.original_m6 is the actual OriginalM6 closed theorem; its first conjunct gives PointwiseCorrect on these literal polynomials. PointwiseCorrect already includes CountingCorrect, ParametersCorrect, AnswerCorrect (actual solve/NoLogical/minimum X and JZ witness), ExecutionCorrect and StorageCorrect. M7.Transport.distance unfolds to the same quantumDistance. Do not assume AnswerCorrect, a supplied distance, or an oracle. Introduce inputs, obtain connected_admissible, then apply the first conjunct of original_m6. Return tactic lines without leading by.
